system.description:
Flexible origin — the Red Waste pits, the Depsopteron slave pits, the Fight Club of Mournas, or the lighter tournament circuit. You learned to fight in front of a crowd.

  • Crowd's Favourite: Advantage on your first attack roll each round against a creature you have already struck this combat.
  • Arena Presence: Advantage on Performance and Persuasion checks when addressing a crowd.
